contract.objective: Replace the confirm-before-start model gate with start-on-session-model, a non-blocking recommendation card, and a per-project per-host saved profile, on both Claude Code and Codex; correct the Codex hook and role-wiring claims.
requested: start every role on the user's session model without waiting for confirmation
after starting, recommend per-role model and effort; the user can accept, change, or refine
save the user's answer per project and host so later sessions do not ask again
apply to Claude Code and Codex
add hooks {} to the Codex manifest and correct Codex documentation
excluded: raising any role above the session model or saved profile without user confirmation
raw prompts, private reasoning, credentials, or account data in the profile

requestedItems.description: model-policy.md, AGENTS.md, execution-allocation.md describe start-on-session-model, non-blocking card, saved profile, and upgrade-only confirmation.
model-policy.py profile validation with tests; profile file format documented.
claude-tools.md and codex-tools.md state how each host inherits the session model and how a saved profile is applied, with verification status.
hooks {} in .codex-plugin/plugin.json; constitution, README and codex-tools.md corrected about hook trust, symlinked roles, and fork_turns.
Live scenarios on Claude and Codex: delegation without a saved profile does not stall; a saved profile's reviewer model is used.

acceptance.description: All Chohogi verifiers and the unittest suite pass.
